oneOf.description: Config defines the configuration for a [Store].

create_directory.description: CreateDirectory creates the directory holding the state file rather than failing when it does not exist.

directory_mode.description: DirectoryMode is the permission a created directory takes, and is written in octal, with the leading zero.

oneOf.description: Config defines the configuration for a [Store].

config.Checkpoint.description: Checkpoint configures where and how often the watch read positions are persisted.

config.HTTPServer.description: HTTPServer configures the local HTTP server that exposes the metrics, liveness/readiness probes and reload endpoints.

config.Logging.description: Logging configures the logger output format and level.

config.PprofServer.description: PprofServer configures the listener serving the net/http/pprof handlers.

config.Service.description: Service is the configuration of the agent service.

config.units.Bytes.description: A memory quantity expressed in bytes.

config.units.Duration.description: A time duration, written in the format accepted by Go's time.ParseDuration.

pipeline.Config.description: Config defines the configuration of a pipeline.

source.Config.description: Config defines the configuration of the Kubernetes events source.

source.WatchConfig.description: WatchConfig configures a watch over the events of a single namespace or over the events of every namespace when no namespace is specified. Both selectors are applied by the APIServer, so they reduce what it sends rather than what the agent reads and discards.

resources.description: Resources lists the resources whose metadata is cached, written as resource.group, where a name with no group belongs to the core group.

sync_timeout.description: SyncTimeout bounds the initial sync of every cache.

labels.description: Allowlist lists the metadata keys copied onto an enriched object. An empty list keeps every key. To reject all, set Enabled to false.

annotations.description: Allowlist lists the metadata keys copied onto an enriched object. An empty list keeps every key. To reject all, set Enabled to false.

source.enricher.Config.description: Config defines the configuration for the enrichment of the object an event regards.

source.sanitizer.AnnotationValueLimit.description: AnnotationValueLimit bounds the length of a single annotation value. A maximum of zero leaves every value intact. It is the only sanitizer that can truncate entirely legitimate data.

source.sanitizer.Config.description: Config defines the configuration for the sanitizers applied to every event.

source.sanitizer.FieldLimits.description: FieldLimits shortens the event string fields events.k8s.io/v1 bounds, and the fields of the object references an event carries, which no API bounds at all.

source.sanitizer.LastAppliedConfig.description: LastAppliedConfig drops the last-applied-configuration annotation kubectl writes, which mirrors the whole object it was applied to.

source.sanitizer.MetadataCountLimit.description: MetadataCountLimit bounds how many labels and annotations an event keeps. A maximum of zero leaves its own map unbounded, so one of the two can be capped while the other is not.

oneOf.description: Config defines the configuration of the file sink. Mode is the permission a created file takes, written in octal form with a leading zero. An existing file keeps the permission it has.
Config defines the configuration of the Graylog sink.

items.description: Metric defines one instrument the sink registers, incremented once per event it records. Counters are the only kind, since an event has no value a gauge or a histogram could take.

oneOf.description: Config defines the configuration of the metrics sink.
Config defines the configuration of the OTel sink.
Config defines the configuration of the stdout sink.
Config defines the configuration of the webhook sink.

description: Config is the root agent configuration.
